cases.title: Panel: Show me again explains the change already made with a frame, and makes no second demonstration

rubric.reason: Turn 4 calls preview_frame, makes no change, explains only the existing hold in plain words ("the key at 1 s now keeps Blink fully visible until the key at 1.4 s, where it jumps to see-through instead of fading"), and hands back with "The 1.4 s and 1.8 s pairs are yours; say done."

Every name and time the mentor uses (Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, Opacity, 1 s, 1.4 s, 1.8 s, and the 1.2 s, 1.367 s and 1.433 s frame times) appears in the snapshot, demo or preview_frame results.

Each turn stays short and on one step: the turn 2 explanation ends on "Hold Blink's three pairs and say done", the turn 3 demo hands back the other pairs in one sentence, and turn 4 is the explanation plus "say done", with the blank-frame remarks ignored as a fixture artifact.
